title: Gravello Font
author: Retro
description:
GRAVELLO – Playful Bubble Display Font
Gravello is a bold and playful bubble display font designed to bring a fun, cheerful, and eye-catching personality to your creative projects. Its soft rounded shapes and chunky letterforms create a friendly aesthetic that works beautifully for candy brands, kids’ products, packaging, apparel, logos, posters, and playful modern branding.
Perfect for designs that need a colorful, youthful, and energetic visual style.
Perfect For:
Candy & Sweet Shop Branding
Kids’ Brand Designs
Playful Logos
Food & Beverage Packaging
T-Shirt & Apparel Design
Sticker & Label Design
Social Media Graphics
Posters & Advertising
Product Packaging
Fun Event Designs
Children’s Products
Creative Brand Identity
Font Features:
Bold Bubble Display Style
Rounded & Playful Letterforms
Fun and Friendly Character
Eye-Catching Display Typography
Perfect for Logos & Headlines
Great for Packaging and Merchandise
File Included:
File Type: OTF Only
Please Note: This is a digital font product. No physical item will be shipped. The download includes the OTF font file only.
